segments.text: Ari watches rhythm, not content. In this real session, it looks at typing, scrolling, app switching, and idle time.
From those signals, Ari builds a simple picture of what is going on. It estimates focus, overload, fatigue, and stability before it decides what to do.
When a limit is reached, Ari takes a real step. Here, it quiets notifications to protect deep work.
That means fewer interruptions while the person stays in focus.
The ending shows why Ari acted, how sure it was, and how the system returns to normal.
